sources.contract: Public TerrainGenerator holds raw period and grid scale; new uses period 30, generate forwards period to noiz and samples before final terrain validation.
Native trait says unusual zero/infinite period/frequency not recommended, set_period takes reciprocal, concrete Noise stores raw f32 and multiplies sampling input by frequency.
Grid dimensions/physical scale are validated before sampling; generated height samples are checked finite afterward.
Inspected caller sets finite positive period 200.0 before generate.

observations.reasoning: The raw public parameter lacks the stronger application period policy before native reciprocal; e.g. zero implies an infinite reciprocal in f32 source math. This alone does not establish an invalid authored input, native algorithm outcome, panic, or production failure. The sample implementation in sibling modules was not inspected; later finite-height checks do not prove behavior before the check.
observations.future_direction: Determine supported noise wavelength/frequency domain and producer bounds, then represent/admit at the application owner and preserve the external native adapter. Maintain the documented seed low-word boundary; do not impose nonzero seed based on SDK.

sources.contract: Every i64 microsecond value can be constructed. Negative timestamp conversion negates signed micros before casting, so i64::MIN cannot be represented by unary signed negation; behavior depends on overflow-check settings.
The related signed duration type uses unsigned_abs instead.
Inspected first-party path extracts raw micros from reducer timestamp and uses its own clock projection, not this conversion.
The inspected strategic clock projection uses signed saturating subtraction, clamps negative elapsed time, and has its own inverse checked subtraction.

observations.reasoning: Conditional native source edge, no claimed product path reaching i64::MIN, native panic execution, platform clock range, or all timestamp consumers. Preserve prior central reviewer and distinguish Unix point from signed duration and strategic minute.
observations.history: ASSESSMENT-L01-HISTORICAL-495 and 059 READ-L11-411/L12 tail explicitly retain the minimum edge as conditional, not an independently counted application failure.

observations.classification: Bounded source observation about external API, application reachability and policy open; no new project defect/count.

sources.contract: checked_add/sub with signed duration use checked i64 arithmetic; checked_add_duration/checked_sub_duration first convert std Duration to signed TimeDuration; operators unwrap checked outputs.
Conversion expects microsecond magnitude to fit i64, so oversized duration fails before checked arithmetic returns Option.

observations.reasoning: Native conversion can panic for a Duration with microseconds above i64::MAX even when a caller chose a checked timestamp API. No direct first-party call to these names was found in the bounded repository navigation and no application witness or runtime was established.
observations.future_direction: If a real caller can receive such durations, establish an application range or handle the fallible native boundary; preserve documented SDK behavior and avoid assuming every checked call is panic-free.
observations.history: Related to 059 q577/q1923 and original L12 connected tail; different arithmetic trigger from i64::MIN conversion, no automatic alias.

sources.contract: The field is signed i64 microseconds and constructor accepts i64; documentation says approximately 292 years.

observations.reasoning: The declared i64 microsecond span is approximately 292,000 years on either side of Unix epoch, not 292 years. Actual SystemTime/chrono supported range is a separate unassessed platform/native policy.

nonfindings_and_limits: SeedableNoise accepts any u32 including zero; first-party source explicitly exports the low word of the existing seed, which is a native width boundary rather than evidence of accidental seed collision policy. lenses.name: producer-propagation
lenses.assessment: Terrain period public generator → native reciprocal/retained frequency → sample → post-sample terrain admission traced within registered windows. Reducer timestamp → stored raw epoch → strategic projection traced; other producers and consumers remain open.

lenses.name: existing-type-owners
lenses.assessment: Native SeedableNoise u32, ScalableNoise f32 and Timestamp point vs TimeDuration span are concrete owners; application units/range owner not supplied merely by SDK types.

lenses.name: admission-contracts
lenses.assessment: Unrestricted i64 timestamp constructor and raw f32 period expose wider native domain; actual application domain and all constructors remain open. Grid and final finite heights have separate guards.

lenses.name: invariant-operations
lenses.assessment: Signed minimum negation and oversized Duration conversion are separate conditional native operations. Period reciprocal and coordinate multiplication require real input and algorithm policy; no executed behavior.

lenses.name: aggregate-states
lenses.assessment: Generated terrain dimensions, physical scale, frequency and sample values share a geometric contract but are checked at different stages. Clock epoch and current timestamp are distinct inputs to a projection.

lenses.name: type-ownership
lenses.assessment: First-party terrain wavelength and strategic wall-epoch policy remain application ownership questions; foreign SDK owns its native interfaces and should not be silently rewritten.

lenses.name: redundant-authority
lenses.assessment: Period is converted to frequency on set; retained frequency is the library representation, no separate retained contradictory period in inspected native Noise. Persisted clock epoch and calculated official minute have projection roles; no dual authority defect inferred.

lenses.name: behavior-preservation
lenses.assessment: The same exact package versions/members are selected by 6533 and 95e lockfiles; this is identity not proof of identical dependency feature selection or application behavior.

lenses.name: enum-shapes
lenses.assessment: No unsupported enum/state flattening established in native scope; checked Option and Result contracts, signed/unsigned duration and wasm/native APIs remain distinct semantics.

lenses.name: derivability
lenses.assessment: Native derives, generic implementations and methods serve external library contracts; no equivalent derive replacement established from this bounded project review.

lenses.name: type-granularity
lenses.assessment: Epoch instant, elapsed signed duration, strategic minute, noise wavelength, frequency and seed have distinct units/ranges; do not equate them simply because they share raw primitives.

lenses.name: magic-strings
lenses.assessment: Timestamp parses RFC3339 and emits native temporal text; diagnostic context/expect messages are boundary prose, not proved business state classifiers. Native package identity strings are metadata.

lenses.name: magic-numbers
lenses.assessment: Microsecond units, reciprocal frequency, low-word native seed, default/caller periods and checked arithmetic carry separate meaning. Review unusual/extreme values at actual producer boundaries without banning zero seeds or inventing runtime outcomes.
